lines.zh: 我卷成一圈，靠着滚动走。
lines.en: I curl into a wheel and travel by rolling.

lines.zh: 一圈一圈，地面的沙子都被我搅起。
lines.en: Roll by roll, I stir up the sand.
I stop and unfold myself.

lines.zh: 我的节片一片片挤在一起。
lines.en: My segments press together one by one.

lines.zh: 我顺着小小的坡滚下去。
lines.en: I roll down the small slope.
Unfurled, I crawl on fine legs.

lines.zh: 我滚到石头边上，停住了。
lines.en: I roll up to a stone and stop.

lines.zh: 我的壳一碰到东西就弹开。
lines.en: My shell springs off whatever it hits.
I curl up again and roll a while.

lines.zh: 我滚过的地上留了一道浅痕。
lines.en: A faint groove marks where I rolled.
I roll between the grass stems.
I turn and roll on in a new direction.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滚到有树荫的地方。
lines.en: I roll slowly into the shade.

lines.zh: 我停住的时候会晃两下。
lines.en: I wobble twice when I stop.
I've put my legs out again.
I drift off line and bump something.

lines.zh: 我卷成一个球，一动不动。
lines.en: I'm a ball, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我的壳是灰色的，一节一节的。
lines.en: My shell is grey and segmented.
I poke my head out between the plates.
My antennae probe the soil.
The sun warms my shell.
A few legs are still showing.
I tighten a little.
The damp in the soil feels good.

lines.zh: 我一动不动的，别人会以为我是石子。
lines.en: Holding still, I pass for a pebble.

lines.zh: 我的腿在壳下轻轻地划。
lines.en: My legs paddle faintly under the shell.
I curl tighter.
An ant goes past me.
I tuck my antennae under my shell.
I loosen one leg slowly.
Under the dead leaves is my place.
There's a little mud on my shell.

lines.zh: 我离你的鞋带只有一寸。
lines.en: I am an inch from your bootlace.

lines.zh: 我小得能塞进你的鞋印。
lines.en: I am small enough to fit your bootprint.
I've curled myself rounder.
I shift, and only then do you see me.
I unfold one leg slowly.
Are you going to step on me?
I rolled away half a foot.
I raise my head, antennae toward you.
I'm not fast at all.
Your boot tip is half a foot from me.
I've rolled back into a ball.
It's cool in your shadow.
I've balled up at once.
I rolled several steps away.
That hit my shell.
I roll myself into a tiny ball.

lines.zh: 过了好一会儿我才展开。
lines.en: It's a while before I unfold.
All my legs are drawn in.
There's a new mark on my shell.
I stay curled until it leaves.
I roll slowly behind the stone.
I wobble; my shell has not cracked.

lines.zh: 烂木头的气味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of rotten wood drifts over.
I roll slowly over.
This lump smells faintly sweet.
I sniffed it first.
I put my legs out and took hold.
Two bites and it is gone.
I eat and curl up at the same time.
Set it closer to me.

lines.zh: 这味儿像我出生的土堆。
lines.en: This smells like the soil I was born in.
Done eating, and I'm a ball again.
Turn the leaf over.
I eat from the underside.
Better than dead leaves.
I've rolled a little way back.
I nibble a bit, then pause.
This will last me a while.
You touched me and I rolled away.
I bounce up and drop back to the soil.
That one put me into a stone.
My shell bounced.
I'm curled tight — nothing hurt.
I've rolled into the grass.
I roll slowly back.
You knocked me off my line.
My legs are pulled in.
I wait a while before unfolding.
Another rolls over, also curled.
We bump and bounce apart.
It unfolds; so do I.
We curl together, legs crossing.
Its antennae tap against mine.
This rotting leaf is enough for both of us.
It curls up; so do I.
We roll a lap together.
Then it rolled off elsewhere.
I stay curled where I am.
I take hold of the leaf with my legs.
It's so dry it crumbles at a touch.
I haul it under a leaf with my legs.
I push it; it rolls half an inch.
I curl up and carry it off.
It's stuck between my segments.
I sniff it; not great.
I gnaw at it slowly.
It fell from between my legs.
I roll it against the stone.
Something is shifting on the sand.
I put my legs out slowly.
I've unfolded halfway.

lines.zh: 那东西就在我的触角前。
lines.en: That thing is just before my antennae.
I rolled a little way over.
I smell the damp on its body.
I roll toward that direction.
One short roll is all I need.
Curled up, I watch through one gap.
I've hooked it with my legs.
I roll after it slowly.
It goes left; I roll left.
I roll slow but never pause.
It stops, and I stop too.
Roll by roll I close in.
It stepped on me.
I ball up and it trips.

lines.zh: 它后退时被我绊了一下。
lines.en: Its retreat catches on me.
All my legs are out.
I've curled myself tight.
I roll into it.
I butt with my shell's edge.
I ball up and press into it.
I ball up and ram its heel.
I butt against its toe.
I roll another turn.
I hit its ankle.
I hit it and land on my shell's rim.
The rim of my shell scrapes it.
I'm a ball again.
I roll up out of the soil.
First thing I do is curl into a ball.
I push up from under the rotting leaves.
Dead leaves lie scattered around.
I put my legs out one by one.
I try rolling half a turn.

lines.zh: 枯叶下面，我先动了动腿。
lines.en: Under the dead leaves, I move my legs first.
Footsteps press the sand far off.
I roll that way.
The sun has warmed my shell.

lines.zh: 热气从节片缝里钻进来。
lines.en: Heat creeps in between my segments.
I roll off the slope and come apart.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的壳里，我沉了。
lines.en: Water seeps into my shell and I sink.

lines.zh: 我被炸得翻了三个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me over three times.

lines.zh: 一支箭打在我壳上，弹开了。
lines.en: An arrow hits my shell and bounces off.

lines.zh: 我的身体自己卷得更紧了。
lines.en: My body curls tighter on its own.
I'm too hungry to keep my ball.
Lightning seeps in through my shell seams.

lines.zh: 下面没有土了，我滚下去。
lines.en: No soil below; I go rolling down.
